name: contact_pickup_sfx
rationale: On actor contact, finalizes the nearest pickup and plays its sound (sfx_voice_manager); called from contact_vs_actor_handler.

name: respawn_collision_reset
rationale: Rebuilds/zeroes the collision candidate state on respawn/level reset (collision_candidate_builder + memset).

name: projectile_aim
rationale: Computes a projectile aim/heading toward a target: distance (SquareRoot0) + angle (atan2_heading). Used by the blue-shooter plant.

name: loadscreen_image_setup
rationale: Sets up a load/boot screen: clears VRAM (ClearImage), uploads the image (LoadImage), enables display (SetDispMask), and loads an audio bank.
